data.one_liner: A customizable ExpansionTile widget with configurable header, colors, and animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a drop‑in replacement for Flutter's ExpansionTile that lets you supply custom header widgets, control animation curves, and add pre/post header widgets. A controller can be used to programmatically expand or collapse the tile.
use_when: You need a highly customized expansion tile beyond the default Flutter widget
You want to animate or replace parts of the tile header dynamically
avoid_when: The default ExpansionTile meets your needs and you don't require extra customization
You need a full‑featured list or accordion component with more features
strengths: Fine‑grained control over header and animation
Null‑safety and supports recent Flutter versions
Simple API, just add the package
weaknesses: Limited to expansion‑tile use‑case, no broader UI components
